analysis.summary: Accent Microcell Ltd conducted its earnings conference call for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. Management reported strong demand for Microcrystalline Cellulose (MCC) with an order book of approximately 4,000 metric tons and total FY26 sales volume of 15,000 metric tons. Commercialization of Unit 3 Phase 1 was delayed due to abnormal monsoons and regulatory approvals, but management expects licensing within a month. Phase 2 expansion is slated for March 2027 and will be funded via rights issue proceeds and internal accruals without taking additional debt. Accent Microcell Limited presented its investor presentation for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026.

guidance.claim: Management expects Unit 3 Phase 1 to generate peak capacity revenue of around 150 crores.
guidance.quote: At peak capacity, we are assuming revenue of around, 150 crores.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates blended profit margins to increase by 2 to 3 percentage points due to a higher proportion of premium products.
guidance.quote: It will be prudent enough to assume going ahead, as we are going ahead with more premium range of products, so it is prudent enough to assume that the blended profit margins are going to increase by, say, at least 2-3 percentage.

guidance.claim: Unit-III has a projected revenue of ₹70 crore in Year 1.
Management expects a revenue mix of 60% exports and 40% domestic sales for Unit-III.
The company expects a CAGR of 15% to 20% for the next 3 to 5 years.
guidance.quote: at least say 15 to 20% CAGR for next 3 to 5 years. We are expecting.

guidance.claim: The company expects the capacity utilization of Unit 3 Phase 1 to be around 60% for the first year.
guidance.quote: but yes, from the from current fiscal given a full year capacity, we are expecting it to be utility level, to be around 60% for the 1st year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management reported a good current MCC demand outlook based on their order book.
demand_outlook.quote: So, currency, current, MCC demand outlook is good, taking into account our existing order book.

demand_outlook.claim: Management does not foresee any demand challenges in the near future.
demand_outlook.quote: So, we don't foresee any kind of challenges, at least in near future.

demand_outlook.claim: Export revenue accounted for roughly 63% of overall sales compared to 53% in the prior financial year.
demand_outlook.quote: ODAC exports, it's roughly, say, around 63%, which was, 53% last year.

demand_outlook.claim: Exports contributed ₹22,086.80 Lakhs, representing 63.28% of the company's revenue.
demand_outlook.quote: 22,086.80 Lakhs (63.28%) of the Company’s Revenue comes from exports.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic sales contributed ₹12,816.48 Lakhs, accounting for 36.72% of total revenue.
demand_outlook.quote: 12,816.48 Lakhs (36.72%) of the Company’s Revenue comes from domestic markets.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects the global MCC market demand to grow by an extra 1% to 1.5% in the upcoming couple of years.
demand_outlook.quote: So for current scenario, of course, as I mentioned earlier, that it's positive impact. By 1.1 point 5% extra.

demand_outlook.claim: The company has witnessed an overall increase in market demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Yes, as I mentioned earlier, that yes, my market demand has been increased overall.

capex_expansion.claim: The delay in Phase 1 of Unit 3 was due to abnormal monsoons and regulatory licensing requirements.
capex_expansion.quote: The delay in Phase 1 was, primarily due to two reasons, two back-to-back abnormal monsoons, and, certain licensing work, read with, say, regulatory approvals that was required, being, project treated as, greenfield.

capex_expansion.claim: Unit 3 Phase 1 has a planned capacity of 2,400 metric tons per annum for premium excipient products.
capex_expansion.quote: Madam, we need to… read with, weighted average capacity, the capacity of, Unit 3, phase 1 is 2,400 metric ton per nm.

capex_expansion.claim: Management expects Unit 3 Phase 2 to go live in March 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 2, say, it will be premature for me to give any kind of an exact deadline, but as of now, we are expecting it to go live in the month of, March 27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has acquired land sufficient for expansion up to Phase 6.
capex_expansion.quote: Good question Mr. Priyank, we have purchased land for till phase 6.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 3 is tentatively planned to start in 2028 after achieving full capacity in Phase 2.
capex_expansion.quote: Almost in 2028 will start the Phase 3.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to set up Phase 2 for Unit 3.
capex_expansion.quote: And we are also planning to set up the good amount of content already we have, declared the quantity where we are planning to. Set up for our unique 3 phase, 2.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects Phase 1 of Unit 3 to come on stream by Quarter 3 of the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, sir. By say, quarter 3 of the current financial year. So anywhere between, say by the end of October or in the 1st couple of weeks of November.

capex_expansion.claim: The capex for Phase 2 is around 55 to 60 crores, excluding the value of land.
capex_expansion.quote: sir, it is around 55 to 60 crore, except the value of land.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved a gross profit margin of approximately 38%.
margins_costs.quote: gross profit percentage is around 38%, so I guess, more or less, your concern, or rather, the question will be answered through that percentage.

margins_costs.claim: Domestic sales realizations range between 170 to 190 rupees per kg, leading to an overall weighted average realization of 250 to 260 rupees per kg.
margins_costs.quote: The domestic realization ranges between anywhere between 170 to 190 rupees. So, on a weighted average basis, the volume, or the amount that you have referred to, comes to around 250 or 260 rupees per kg.

margins_costs.claim: Profit margins on trading operations are approximately 4% to 5%.
margins_costs.quote: And about the trading margins, I think we have said it earlier as well. Trading margins are 4-5%, as compared to the, blended profit margins that what you are seeing in the phase of the profit and loss account.

margins_costs.claim: Increases in wood pulp raw material costs have been fully passed on to customers.
margins_costs.quote: Sir, whatever the, say, nominal increase in the cost, for the import of raw material that is wood pulp has been completely passed on through the customer.

margins_costs.claim: The price of CCS is around 3.5 times the price of MCC.
margins_costs.quote: The price of CC. CCS is around 3.5 times of MCC.

margins_costs.claim: The company expects a 5% to 7% increase in the sales of finished goods due to its new range of premium excipient products.
margins_costs.quote: so roughly, you can say around say, 5 to 7 percentage say, increase in the sales of finished goods because of the new range that we have started selling off, namely, SMCC, Spheres powder cellulose, and other say, combination co-process. MCC.

orders_capacity.claim: The company holds an existing order book of approximately 4,000 metric tons across domestic and export markets.
orders_capacity.quote: Taking into account, say, domestic and export market, we have roughly around, 4,000 metric tons orders on hand with us.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity across existing facilities stands at approximately 10,000 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Yeah, and the installed capacity for both the plant is roughly around 10,000 metric ton.

orders_capacity.claim: Total volume sales reached 15,000 metric tons in FY26.
The company maintains confirmed order visibility for 3 to 4 months in export and domestic markets.
orders_capacity.quote: for, at least for 3 to 4 months, we have ordered books on hand for export and domestic markets.

orders_capacity.claim: Unit-I at Pirana has an installed capacity of 2,000 MTPA with 100% capacity utilization.
The company currently has about 4 to 5 months of business on hand.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes, we have at present about, you can say for 4 to 5 months. We have business on hand, and that's why.

orders_capacity.claim: The current capacity of the company is around 9,600 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: 9,600 is our current capacity, so our phase? One, is about 2,400.

orders_capacity.claim: Phase 1 capacity at 100% utilization will be around 2,400 metric tons per annum and Phase 2 will be 12,000 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes, sir, phase one at 100% capacity utilization. It will be around 2,400 metric ton per annum and phase 2 will be 12,000 metric ton

orders_capacity.claim: The total capacity of the company will be 24,000 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: So it will. Total will be 24,000 metric ton per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: The capacity utilization of the Pirana plant was 100% throughout the year for all three years.
orders_capacity.quote: Definitely the capacity utilization from pirana plant was 100% throughout the year. For all the 3 years.

capital_allocation.claim: Phase 2 capex will be funded through rights issue proceeds and internal accruals without requiring working capital borrowings.
capital_allocation.quote: Because Phase 2, Phase 2, we are going to fund it out from right issue, and to a certain extent, internal equals. And for working capital, we… as of now, we don't foresee any kind of further borrowing requirements.

capital_allocation.claim: Management foresees that internal accruals will be sufficient for future funding needs without new debt.
capital_allocation.quote: I think, the internal accruals will suffice the requirement. As of now, we don't see any kind of such debt requirements.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised around 40 crores through a rights issue.
capital_allocation.quote: Apart from that. Just to be clear for the fund raising that what you have done for the right issue. It is around 40 crores, and the total cost of phase 2 will be around roughly between 55 to 60 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Wood pulp raw material imports are sourced from the USA, Sweden, Canada, and Indonesia.
risks_headwinds.quote: So, basically, we import it from USA, Sweden, Canada, Indonesia.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions have created transit time challenges without affecting raw material prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: Sir in this the situation is that due to geopolitical tension there is no fluctuation in prices. Whatever delay there is and whatever challenges there are they are related to transit time to the extent what you have understood so far.

risks_headwinds.claim: The financial results reflect exceptional expense impacts arising from implementation of new labor codes.
risks_headwinds.quote: And in addition to OBO, there was an, say, kind of an exceptional item in the current year as well, wherein the, huge impact of the labor code was also taken by us.

risks_headwinds.claim: Two consecutive abnormal monsoon seasons impacted on-site execution activities.
risks_headwinds.quote: Two consecutive abnormal monsoon seasons impacting on-site execution activities

risks_headwinds.claim: Execution timelines were affected by extended liaisoning timelines for obtaining regulatory approvals.
risks_headwinds.quote: Extended liaisoning timelines for obtaining the required regulatory approvals

management_commitments.claim: Phase 1 commercial production will commence within one month following receipt of pollution and GPCB licenses.
management_commitments.quote: Will get the license by one month so phase 1 will start.

management_commitments.claim: Unit 3 Phase 2 is expected to go live in March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: Phase 2, say, it will be premature for me to give any kind of an exact deadline, but as of now, we are expecting it to go live in the month of, March 27.

management_commitments.claim: Working capital receivable days will be normalized by the end of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Sir, if not by, H1 of financial year 27, surely by, say, end of financial 27, it will be taken care of.

management_commitments.claim: Phase 3 expansion is tentatively scheduled to start in 2028.
management_commitments.quote: Almost in 2028 will start the Phase 3.

management_commitments.claim: Unit-III has a projected revenue of ₹70 crore in Year 1.
The company expects a CAGR of 15% to 20% for the next 3 to 5 years.
management_commitments.quote: at least say 15 to 20% CAGR for next 3 to 5 years. We are expecting.
